name: ADONIS (Base (v2.1))
description: Main and Alt is now Base & Refine Base and Refine models are now used together, with Base setting the image and Refine finishing the details. There should be very little shifting when using the models in this way. The models have been block edited to have slightly less effect on color/saturation, as the Main and Alt version tended to undersaturate the outputs to an extreme degree. The new workflow will be posted with the changes in place.
